versions.changelog:
Photoreal Stills 1.0.0

- Introduces a skill to generate images that convincingly resemble real photographs across genres: portraits, editorial, documentary, food, interiors, and lifestyle.
- Provides comprehensive prompting and workflow guidance to avoid typical "AI look" artifacts (plastic skin, symmetry, flat light, over-saturation) using camera, lens, film, lighting, and imperfection cues.
- Details live model selection procedures, emphasizing using real-time schema and prompt best practices to maximize realism.
- Includes a systematic anti-AI-look checklist covering optics, texture, imperfections, lighting, and color restraint.
- Offers genre-specific starting points and precise recommendations for lifelike output in various photographic scenarios.
